---
name: RFC intent (normative / architectural change)
about: You want to change what OAAF adopts, profiles, extends, or invents
labels: rfc
---

Normative changes go through the [RFC process](../../rfcs/README.md). Open this issue first
to agree the problem before drafting, so two people do not draft the same thing.

**Problem**

What is impossible or wrong today.

**Charter fit**

Does this answer "is this actor authorized to perform this action under this authority?"

**Which surface changes**

Authority profile / a transport binding / reason codes / explanation contract / other.

**Standards**

The existing standard you expect to adopt, profile, or extend — or why none fits.

**Compatibility & reserved-IP**

Any compatibility impact you foresee, and confirmation this touches none of the
[reserved concepts](../../CHARTER.md#reserved-concepts).
